title: Number wall on lock screen causing other apps to restart
symptom: External Android apps appear to restart at the precise Xdrip+ polling interval: Chrome web content refreshes and clears unsubmitted input fields, social media feeds refresh to the top of the scroll, and YouTube videos stop and reset to the beginning. The reported symptom was later narrowed to the xDrip+ lock screen number wall refreshing every 5 minutes.
cause: The xDrip+ lock screen number wall refresh on Android 12 interrupts other apps, causing them to restart. Disabling the lock screen number display resolves it.
fix: Disable the xDrip+ lock screen number display / Number Wall feature. Removing the value from the lock screen was reported to 100% fix the issue.
evidence_quote: Removing the value from the lock screen has 100% fixed the issue.
